# Import packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(robotstxt)
library(readxl)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(viridis)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidygeocoder)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(maps)
```

# Import wrangled dataset
```{r}
wrangled_data <- load("data/wrangledData.Rdata")
```

# Create visualization of US map
```{r}
# count_df is already created but we need to create a map of the US states and a map of ALL counties instead of just MA
state_df <- map_data("state")

state_map <- maps::map("state", regions = "."
                       , plot = FALSE, fill = TRUE) |>
  st_as_sf()

county_map <- maps::map("county", regions = "."
                        , plot = FALSE, fill = TRUE) |>
  st_as_sf()

# Map county within the states
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data=county_map, aes(geometry=geom)
          , fill = "lightgrey", color = "white") +
  geom_sf(data=state_map, aes(geometry=geom)
          , fill = NA, color = "black") +
  theme_void()
```
